method: Small-sample Sunday estimate-to-final revision mixture at exact8m boundary; majority weight on symmetric unknown revision, minority on five corrected same-week errors. Primary weights/variances, not calibrated posterior.

components.relative_revision: Uniform selection of five corrected errors +Normal(0,.02) kernel

unchanged_exact8m_atom.basis: Exact8m ties resolve higher bracket NO; subjective mass, not proven frequency.

source_or_fallback_branch.basis: Table discrepancy/late credible fallback, subjective broad allowance; no claimed50/50 procedural resolution.

limits: Not final data. Exactly8m is NO, tiny downward actual revision is YES. Five films share one weekend/source; openings differ from holdovers and publisher projections differ from studio data. Root corrected horizon errors before own quotes. Broad range deliberately exceeds modeled kernel sensitivities. Possible same-night estimate/actual update makes passive fill selection material. API endOct18 noon is not actuals deadline; source finality/ambiguity may delay throughOct23+.
